mapper.select: WITH PARAMS AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(CAST(#{hsCodes,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE REGEXP_SPLIT_TO_ARRAY(BTRIM(CAST(#{hsCodes,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*') END AS HS_CODE_ARRAY ) SELECT FR.FTA_CODE AS "FTA_CODE", HC.HS_CODE AS "HS_CODE", FR.RULE_CONTENTS AS "COMP_RULE", CASE WHEN FR.BD_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.BD_RULE WHEN FR.BU_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.BU_RULE WHEN FR.NC_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.NC_RULE WHEN FR.MC_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.MC_RULE END AS "RVC_RATE" FROM FTA_RULE FR CROSS JOIN PARAMS P INNER JOIN HS_CODE HC ON FR.HS_CODE = SUBSTR(HC.HS_CODE, 1, LENGTH(FR.HS_CODE)) WHERE CAST(HC.HS_CODE AS TEXT) = ANY(P.HS_CODE_ARRAY) AND FR.HS_CODE_SUB_CATEGORY = '1' ORDER BY HC.HS_CODE, FR.FTA_CODE, FR.RULE_SEQ, FR.CTH_RULE

choose.otherwise: UPDATE PO_LEDGER PL SET COO_TYPE = #{COO_CERTIFY_TYPE}, COO_CERTIFY_NO = #{COO_CERTIFY_NO}, UPDATE_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDATE_BY = #{USER_ID} WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EXT_COO_CERTIFY_MST CCM INNER JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_DTL CCD ON CCD.COO_CERTIFY_NO = CCM.COO_CERTIFY_NO AND CCD.VENDOR_CODE = CCM.VENDOR_CODE AND CCD.DIVISION_CODE = CCM.DIVISION_CODE AND CCD.COMPANY_CODE = CCM.COMPANY_CODE WHERE PL.COMPANY_CODE = CCD.COMPANY_CODE AND CAST(PL.WAREHOUSING_NO AS TEXT) = CAST(CCD.WAREHOUSING_NO AS TEXT) AND CAST(PL.SEQ AS TEXT) = CAST(CCD.WAREHOUSING_SEQ AS TEXT) AND PL.DIVISION_CODE = CCD.DIVISION_CODE AND PL.VENDOR_CODE = CCM.VENDOR_CODE AND PL.ITEM_CODE = CCD.ITEM_CODE AND CCM.COO_CERTIFY_NO = #{COO_CERTIFY_NO} AND CCM.VENDOR_CODE = #{PARAM_VENDOR_CODE} AND CCM.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND CCM.DIVISION_CODE = #{PARAM_DIVISION_CODE} )

mapper.select: SELECT CODE AS "CODE", CODE_NAME AS "CODE_NAME" FROM CODE_DTL WHERE CATEGORY = 'ON' AND COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} ORDER BY SORT_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EXT_COO_CERTIFY_FILE ( COO_CERTIFY_NO ,VENDOR_CODE ,DIVISION_CODE ,COMPANY_CODE ,FILE_SEQ ,FILE_NAME ,FILE_PATH ,ORIGIN_FILE_NAME ,CREATE_DATE ,CREATE_BY ,UPDATE_DATE ,UPDATE_BY ,EXT_COO_FILE ) SELECT #{COO_CERTIFY_NO}, VENDOR_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, FILE_SEQ, FILE_NAME, FILE_PATH, ORIGIN_FILE_NAME, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{USER_ID}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{USER_ID}, EXT_COO_FILE FROM EXT_COO_CERTIFY_FILE WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND DIVISION_CODE = #{PARAM_DIVISION_CODE} AND VENDOR_CODE = #{PARAM_VENDOR_CODE} AND COO_CERTIFY_NO = #{BEFORE_COO_CERTIFY_NO}
